title: Financial Controller
description:
K P Namboodiri's Ayurvedics (KPNA) is a heritage Ayurvedic and herbal wellness brand with a legacy spanning generations, best known for personal care products and now growing into skin and hair care. As we enter our next phase of growth, we're building institutional strength across the organisation, starting with finance.

We're looking for a Finance Controller to build a structured, data-driven finance function from the ground up. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role reporting to the Finance Head, and it sits at the center of how KPNA makes decisions on cost, pricing, and growth.

**WHAT YOU'LL OWN**

**Financial Closing and MIS**

–  Set up and run a disciplined monthly closing process

–  Standardise reporting so leadership gets consistent, timely visibility into revenue, cost, and profitability

**Costing and Profitability**

–  Build SKU-level costing frameworks and standard costing models

–  Drive variance analysis and profitability insights by product and channel

–  Support pricing and margin decisions with real numbers, not estimates

**Inventory and Working Capital**

–  Strengthen inventory tracking, reconciliation, and ageing analysis

–  Improve control and visibility over working capital

**Finance Operations and Controls**

–  Own the accuracy and integrity of day-to-day financial records

–  Build the processes and controls that don't exist yet, not just maintain the ones that do

**Business Partnering**

–  Work directly with sales, marketing, manufacturing, and supply chain to turn numbers into decisions

–  Support the Finance Head in business reviews and planning

**Team Building**

–  Recruit, train, and grow the finance team as the function scales

–  Build capability and a culture of discipline and ownership within the team

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

–  8 to 14 years in finance, ideally in manufacturing or FMCG

–  Strong background in financial reporting, costing, and operational finance

–  Comfortable with financial modelling and finance systems

–  CA or CMA preferred, not mandatory for the right candidate

–  Malayalam or Tamil speaking

**WHY THIS ROLE**

This isn't a maintenance job. KPNA is at a stage where the finance function is being built, not just run, and this role shapes what it becomes. If you want ownership over systems and decision-support rather than routine reporting, this is that role.

**LOCATION**

Thrissur, Kerala (on-site)

title: Odoo Consultant
description:
**Company Description**
Digital Technologies (DIGITZ TECHNOLOGIES) is a leading provider of comprehensive ERP and CRM development and implementation services, supporting businesses in optimizing their operations and customer relationships. The company also delivers web and app development, branding, and digital marketing solutions to help organizations succeed in a competitive digital environment. With an experienced professional team and a strong focus on quality, Digital Technologies supports businesses of all sizes in achieving sustainable growth. The organization is ISO certified and a BNI Global member, reflecting its commitment to standards, collaboration, and professional excellence.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Odoo Consultant role based in Kanayannur. The Odoo Consultant will be responsible for gathering and analyzing client requirements, configuring and customizing Odoo modules, and supporting end-to-end ERP and CRM implementation projects. Daily tasks include mapping business processes, setting up workflows, testing system functionality, and preparing documentation. The role also involves user training, troubleshooting functional issues, coordinating with technical teams for integrations or custom development, and providing ongoing post-implementation support. The consultant will collaborate closely with internal stakeholders and clients to ensure solutions are aligned with business needs and delivered on schedule.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong knowledge of Odoo functional modules (such as Sales, CRM, Inventory, Accounting, HR, Projects) and experience configuring and customizing them to match business processes.
* Experience in ERP and CRM implementation, including requirements gathering, process mapping, gap analysis, solution design, testing, and go-live support.
* Ability to translate business needs into technical specifications and work effectively with developers on integrations, customizations, and data migration.
* Proficiency in documentation, training, and user support, including creating user guides, conducting workshops, and managing change in client organizations.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills, with attention to detail and a structured approach to resolving functional and configuration issues.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work closely with clients and cross-functional teams in a professional, inclusive manner.
* Understanding of business operations in domains such as finance, sales, logistics, or manufacturing; prior consulting or IT services experience is an advantage.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, Engineering, or a related field; relevant Odoo or ERP certifications are a plus.

title: Search Engine Optimization Analyst
description:

 The candidate should be capable of independently managing SEO activities and working closely

 Key Responsibilities
 



 ● Develop and execute effective SEO strategies to improve organic visibility, rankings,
 



 traffic, and conversions.
 



 ● Conduct keyword research and competitor analysis to identify growth opportunities.
 



 ● Perform detailed On\-Page SEO audits and implement recommendations across
 



 websites.
 



 ● Optimize meta titles, meta descriptions, headings, content, URLs, internal linking,
 



 images, and other on\-page elements.
 



 ● Manage and resolve Technical SEO issues, including crawling, indexing, redirects,
 



 canonical tags, sitemap, robots.txt, structured data, and Core Web Vitals.
 



 ● Conduct regular SEO audits and website health checks and provide actionable
 



 recommendations.
 



 ● Implement and manage Local SEO activities, including Google Business Profile
 



 optimization and local keyword strategies.
 



 ● Analyze website performance using Google Search Console and GA4 and identify areas
 



 for improvement.
 



 ● Monitor keyword rankings, organic traffic, conversions, and other SEO KPIs.
 



 ● Prepare and present monthly SEO performance reports with insights and
 



 recommendations.
 



 ● Work closely with content writers and developers to implement SEO recommendations.
 



 ● Identify low\-performing pages and develop strategies to improve their organic traffic and
 



 search visibility.
 



 ● Monitor algorithm updates and industry trends and adjust SEO strategies accordingly.
 



 ● Manage multiple SEO projects simultaneously and ensure activities are completed within
 



 deadlines.
 



 ● Identify and troubleshoot SEO issues independently and provide practical solutions.
 



  





 Required Skills \& Qualifications
 



 ● 2–3 years of hands\-on experience in SEO.
 



 ● Strong expertise in On\-Page, Technical, Off\-Page, and Local SEO.
 



 ● Proficiency in Google Search Console and Google Analytics 4 (GA4\).
 



 ● Experience using SEO tools such as SEMrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, or similar
 



 platforms.
 



 ● Strong expertise in keyword research, competitor analysis, SEO audits, and
 



 performance analysis.
 



 ● Strong knowledge of Technical SEO, crawling, indexing, redirects, canonicalization,
 



 structured data, XML sitemaps, robots.txt, and Core Web Vitals.
 



 ● Experience with Google Business Profile and Local SEO.
 



 ● Strong understanding of content optimization and search intent.
 



 ● Ability to analyze data and convert insights into actionable SEO strategies.
 



 ● Strong communication and coordination skills.
 



 ● Ability to independently manage multiple SEO projects.
 



 ● Strong attention to detail and problem\-solving skills.
 



 ● Ability to work with developers and content teams for SEO implementation.
 



 Preferred Qualifications
 



 ● Experience working with WordPress, Shopify..
 



 ● Experience managing SEO for local and international websites.
 



 ● Experience with e\-commerce SEO is an advantage.
 



 ● Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, IT, or a related field is preferred.
